Question: Which of the following statement(s) is (are) accurate regarding financial management and business structures?  
I. A sole proprietorship has unlimited liability but is the easiest business form to establish.  
II. In a corporation, shareholders have limited liability, but the business faces double taxation.  
III. A limited partnership must have at least one general partner who manages the business and assumes unlimited liability.  
IV. The primary goal of financial management is to maximize shareholder wealth, not just profits.  
V. A general partnership does not require a formal agreement and all partners share liability equally.  
VI. Agency problems arise when managers prioritize personal interests over shareholder interests.

Options:  
    a. I, II, and IV only  
    b. II, III, V, and VI only  
    c. I, II, III, and VI only  
    d. I, III, IV, and V only  
    e. II, IV, V, and VI only  
    f. All I, II, III, IV, V, and VI are true
